enabled.description: When set to `true` sequential ring is enabled.

ringBaseLocationFirstEnabled.description: When set to `true`, the webex calling primary line will ring first.

baseLocationNumberOfRings.description: The number of times the primary line will ring. `baseLocationNumberOfRings` must be between 2 and 20, inclusive.

continueIfBaseLocationIsBusyEnabled.description: When set to `true` and the primary line is busy, the system redirects calls to the numbers configured for sequential ringing.

callsToVoicemailEnabled.description: When set to `true` calls are directed to voicemail.

phoneNumbers.description: A list of up to five phone numbers to which calls will be directed.
